verdict.rationale: Kino AI is a desktop app that runs an MCP server, so a documented update path is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions auto-updates, an update command, release channels, or versioning. The docs and community items cover editing, footage search, templates and review features only.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch
